title: Baked Morbier Tart
description: A savory tart featuring Morbier cheese, puff pastry, and a hint of Ukrainian flair. Perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a small bowl, mix together Ukrainian sausage, salt, and black pepper.
Spread sausage mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Place Morbier cheese on top of the sausage mixture.
Fold pastry edges up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
